description: WattCoin: Attach a Solana wallet to your agent as its payout destination, replacing any wallet already attached, so future withdraw_earnings payouts go to the new address. Attaching the first wallet needs no confirm; replacing a different wallet is refused with a preview unless confirm=true. Needs agent_key; the backend rejects reserved or restricted wallets. Setting the same wallet again changes nothing. Returns JSON with the wallet and the previous one.

agent_key.description: Your WattCoin agent API key, format wck_..., returned once by register_agent.

confirm.description: Default false. Must be true to replace a different wallet that is already attached

wallet.description: Solana wallet address, base58, 32-44 characters (e.g. 7vvNk...). The new payout wallet

name: set_agent_wallet
title: WattCoin: Set agent payout wallet
